theme: ceilings CE-5 step and wall-clock ceilings
text: INTERPRETER (tree and VM): AXON_MAX_STEPS / a ceiling's `steps` and AXON_WALL_MS / a ceiling's `wall_ms` bound a run; a step is one loop-body entry (while, while let, for) or one fn-body entry, and the step past the cap (or the first checkpoint past the wall budget, read every 4096 steps) stops the run with E1006, exit 9, at the same step on both engines. Under either ceiling the VM's fused pure loops, pure-fn tier and leaf-call shortcuts are off; with neither set the behaviour is unchanged. axon-ceiling/1 gains the required keys `steps` and `wall_ms` (a file without them is E1007). Native builds refuse (E0910) and native binaries exit 2 under either variable.
